It was agreed that payment shall be done in four (4) instalments as follows:
	30% of the total contract amount shall be paid to the Service provider after approval of the activities to be performed at the inception phase: Bush clearing and removal of invasive species, Stump debarking/uprooting and creation of Anti erosive ditches;

	20% of the total contract amount shall be paid to the Service provider after approval of the activities for ring weeding and beating up;
	20% of the total contract amount shall be paid to the Service provider after approval of the final reception of activities including maintenance and guarding.
Before signing the contract, the Service provider is required to provide a performance security equivalent to 6% of the total contract amount. description:
The appointed contract management team led by Mr. Anastase NDUWAYEZU will manage this contract on behalf of Rwanda Polytechnic through all managerial activities regarding the proper implementation of this contract.

Due to the nature of this contract, all items are not recorded in the system under deliverables because the contract is turnkey contract that comprises all designs and civil works, supply, installation and commissioning the equipment to be supplied and the related trainings. Therefore, the detailed list pf items and their prices are attached to this contract, and it is an integral part of this contract. The delivery of equipment, civil works and training will be checked against that attached list of items, works and related services including training and commissioning.
The contract amount includes the withholding tax only equivalent to 15% of the total contract amount. It means that the contractor will be paid the remaining amount (Take home amount) after deducting the withholding tax equivalent to 15% of the total contract amount for phase one. 
 
Other taxes, duties and levies at the Rwandan territory will be declared and paid by Rwanda Polytechnic as agreed by contracting parties in the various negotiations.

Other Provisions:
All other terms and conditions of the contract shall remain unchanged and continue to be binding upon both parties.

This amendment pertains to Law No. 009/2025 (effective May 27, 2025), which revises Law No. 049/2023 on Value Added Tax (VAT). The updated legislation amends Article One by removing the VAT exemptions previously granted under items (q) and (r) of Article 8.

As RISA (the central purchasing body for ICT equipment/services) had entered into supplier contracts under the former VAT-exempt framework, this amendment introduces an 18% VAT on all ICT equipment and services to align with the new legal requirements. All other terms and conditions of the original contract remain unchanged.

description:
The appointed contract management team led by Mr. Anastase NDUWAYEZU will manage this contract on behalf of Rwanda Polytechnic through all managerial activities regarding the proper implementation of this contract.

Due to the nature of this contract, all items are not recorded in the system under deliverables because the contract is turnkey contract that comprises all designs and civil works, supply, installation and commissioning the equipment to be supplied and the related trainings. Therefore, the detailed list pf items and their prices are attached to this contract, and it is an integral part of this contract. The delivery of equipment, civil works and training will be checked against that attached list of items, works and related services including training and commissioning.
